headline: 《怒之杀》领跑今日热搜，多部新片齐映
headlineEn: Rage Kill Leads Hot Search as New Films Hit Theaters
summary: 今日影市热闹：3部新片公映，本周累计6部新片。热搜由《怒之杀》《外滩探秘》《玩具总动员5》领衔，《绿灯军团》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》持续升温，备受期待的《最后的日出》即将登场。
summaryEn: A busy day at the box office: 3 films released today, 6 new films this week. Rage Kill, Bund Mystery and Toy Story 5 top the charts, while Green Lantern Corps and Spider-Man: Brand New Day keep heating up. Highly anticipated The Last Sunrise is coming soon.

industryHighlights.text: 今日有3部新片正式上映
industryHighlights.en: Three new films officially released today
Six new films premiere this week
The Last Sunrise announced as upcoming release

industryHighlights.text: 多部热门影片占据热搜榜单
industryHighlights.en: Several hot titles dominate trending charts
